topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I shouldn't have hesitated when they asked. The yard is mostly just sitting there, quiet and unused, while their plot is always bustling with life. It's not like I need all that space to myself. They promised to share the harvest, but the real reason I said yes is the look in their eyes, that hopeful, pleading sort of way they asked. Part of me resents the imposition, the subtle pressure to comply. Yet, here I am, handing over the keys to a piece of my world, hoping it’s enough. I told myself it’s a small price to pay for a little peace.
